help.goal: Race all 15 of your checkers around into your home board, then bear them all off before your opponent does.
steps: Tap 🎲 Roll to throw your two dice.
Tap one of your points to pick up a checker.
Tap a highlighted point, or tap play 5, to use that die.
Play both dice, or all four when you roll a double.
Land on a lone enemy checker to knock it to the bar.
Once every checker is home, tap bear off or the tray.
notes: Checkers on the bar come first: you cannot move anything else until they are all back in.
Bearing off only unlocks when all 15 of your checkers sit in your home board.
No doubling cube here. Every game is worth exactly one win.
